title: Register with ReturnToWorkSA
what: Register with ReturnToWorkSA before employing a worker (or be a self-insured employer).

sources.title: Return to Work Act 2014 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: Subject to subsection (2), an employer must not employ a worker in employment to which this Act applies unless the employer is registered by the Corporation.

confidence_note: Quoted from the Open Australian Legal Corpus copy of the version shown (DECISIONS E-118); later changes not checked. In SA the scheme is run by ReturnToWorkSA, so the duty is registration rather than a private policy.
